items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024
items.q: I mentioned Jimmy Wormworth... you’re playing with Ed Thigpen and Ron — a guitar player Ron? [INTERVIEWEE] Ron Eschete.

ctx.x: Well that’s the easy part. It’s going bing-bing-bing-bing-bing-bing that’s the hard part. You know. Ed Thigpen, a great drummer.
